identity.name: Deutsche Welle
identity.description: Germany's international public broadcaster, offering news and analysis in English and more than 30 other languages with a focus on Europe and global affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Publicly funded international broadcaster. The Deutsche Welle Act requires independence from government influence, though funding and oversight come through the German state.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Statutory independence requirements and editorial guidelines; coverage is not uniformly pro-government and includes criticism of German policy.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Broad public-service framing, generally centrist on German politics with a liberal-democratic institutional orientation.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is explanatory and social-market oriented rather than consistently pro-market or state-directed.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames events through German and EU perspectives, with strong emphasis on European integration and democratic institutions.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established public broadcaster with editorial standards and corrections; MBFC page did not expose a parsed rating in this review.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: MBFC page was retrieved but no clean bias/factual fields were available in the saved page. Assessed from official governance and feed metadata.

intelligence.knownPerspective: German public-broadcaster internationalism. Explains global events through European integration, democratic institutions and German foreign policy, with a strong Africa and Eastern Europe presence.

selectionRationale: Provides a high-quality European public-service perspective and substantial Africa coverage that complements UK/US and state-aligned outlets.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Public-service ownership is structurally distinct from state-controlled media. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
